reviews.author: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Best multi-cultural shop on Charleston. Mir always delivers the cleanest skin fade and razor lineup. Good music, clean shop, and always on point.

reviews.author: Jason P.
reviews.text: Major gave me one of the tightest low tapers I've had in Vegas. The hot towel and beard contour were top notch. Found my new regular spot.

reviews.author: Derrick L.
reviews.text: Hairanesa is incredible with braids and tapers. Immaculate line-up and great vibes. Highly recommend Crowd Pleezers!

reviews.author: Anthony G.
reviews.text: Don is a master with freestyle designs. Clean razor lines and unmatched artistry. Best shop in town.

faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins or are appointments required?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are always welcome during all regular business hours! However, to guarantee your preferred chair and barber without waiting, we highly recommend booking online in advance.

faqs.question: Where are you located and is there parking available?
faqs.answer: We are located at 4960 W Charleston Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89146 in Charleston Decatur Center at Charleston Blvd & Decatur Blvd. We have ample, free parking directly in front of the shop.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Booksy direct pay, and cash.

faqs.question: What is included with a signature haircut?
faqs.answer: Every signature haircut includes a consultation, precision clipper/scissor cut, hot lather razor neck cleanup, hair styling with premium matte products, and aftershave tonic.
